# Zero-limit safeio read allowlist.
#
# `make safeio-read-check` fails when production Go code introduces a
# safeio.ReadFile, safeio.ReadFileUnder, or safeio.ReadFileWithinRoot use, or a
# safeio read whose limit argument is a constant <= 0, unless this file lists
# that callsite. Columns are separated by tabs:
#
#   path  function  callee  index  rationale
#
# index is the 1-based source order of that callee inside the function.
# Each rationale has to explain why that input is still read without a positive
# byte limit. Delete the entry in the same change that gives the callsite a
# positive limit. See docs/safeio-read-bounds.md.

internal/advisory/sync.go	loadSnapshotMetadata	safeio.ReadFile	1	Advisory sync still reads a local snapshot metadata file with ReadFile, which applies no byte limit. Replace this entry when that snapshot load declares one.
internal/analysis/cache_storage.go	analysisCache.lookup	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Analysis cache lookup still reads the cache pointer file with an unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when pointer reads use a positive limit.
internal/analysis/cache_storage.go	readCachedPayload	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Analysis cache payload reads still use unbounded ReadFileUnder for stored result objects. Remove this entry when payload reads declare a byte limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectGoIdentityEvidenceFromPaths	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Go identity enrichment still reads module files from the repository without a declared byte limit. Remove this entry when those reads use ReadFileUnderLimit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	loadGoWorkspaceReplacements	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Go workspace replacement loading still reads go.work with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that workspace file has a positive limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	addJSIdentityPackageEvidence	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	JavaScript identity enrichment still reads package.json files without a declared byte limit. Remove this entry when those manifest reads are bounded.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectPackageLockIdentityEvidenceAtPath	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	npm identity enrichment still reads package-lock.json with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that lockfile read declares a byte limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectYarnLockIdentityEvidenceAtPath	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Yarn identity enrichment still reads yarn.lock with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that lockfile read declares a byte limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectPNPMLockIdentityEvidenceAtPath	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	pnpm identity enrichment still reads pnpm-lock.yaml with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that lockfile read declares a byte limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectGradleDeclarationEvidence	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Gradle identity enrichment still reads build declarations with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Keep this entry until Gradle discovery supplies a positive byte limit here.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectGradleLockIdentityEvidenceFromPath	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Gradle lock identity enrichment still reads the lockfile with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Keep this entry until that Gradle lock read declares a positive limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectSwiftPackageResolvedEvidence	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	SwiftPM identity enrichment still reads Package.resolved with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that resolved-file read declares a byte limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectPodfileLockEvidence	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	CocoaPods identity enrichment still reads Podfile.lock with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that lockfile read declares a byte limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment.go	collectCarthageResolvedEvidence	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Carthage identity enrichment still reads Cartfile.resolved with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that resolved-file read declares a byte limit.

internal/analysis/identity_enrichment_cargo.go	collectCargoLockIdentityEvidence	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Cargo identity enrichment still reads Cargo.lock with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that lockfile read declares a byte limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment_composer_pub.go	readComposerIdentityDeclarations	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Composer identity enrichment still reads composer.json with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that manifest read declares a byte limit.
internal/analysis/identity_enrichment_composer_pub.go	collectComposerLockIdentityEvidence	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Composer identity enrichment still reads composer.lock with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that lockfile read declares a byte limit.

internal/analysis/identity_enrichment_dotnet.go	readNuGetMSBuildDocument	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	NuGet identity enrichment still reads MSBuild project files with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when those project reads declare a byte limit.

internal/lang/kotlinandroid/scan.go	readKotlinAndroidSource	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Kotlin Android source scanning still reads repository Kotlin and Java files with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Keep this entry until that rooted source read declares a byte limit.

internal/lang/shared/codemod.go	LoadCodemodSourceLines	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Shared codemod loading still reads a repository source file with unbounded ReadFileUnder before splitting lines. Remove this entry when that source read declares a byte limit.
internal/lang/shared/source_read.go	ReadSourceFile	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	The shared source helper still reads an arbitrary repository file with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when every caller passes a positive ReadFileUnderLimit.
internal/notify/config.go	LoadConfigOverrides	safeio.ReadFile	1	Notification config loading still reads the selected override file with unbounded ReadFile. Remove this entry when that config read declares a byte limit.
internal/safeio/read.go	ReadFileUnder	safeio.ReadFileUnderLimit	1	ReadFileUnder is the compatibility wrapper that intentionally passes a zero limit into ReadFileUnderLimit. Keep this definition allowlisted so new callers, not the wrapper, must justify a zero limit.
internal/safeio/read.go	ReadFileWithinRoot	safeio.ReadFileWithinRootLimit	1	ReadFileWithinRoot is the compatibility wrapper that intentionally passes a zero limit into ReadFileWithinRootLimit. Keep this definition allowlisted so new callers, not the wrapper, must justify a zero limit.
tools/featureflag/main.go	readCatalogDataFromPath	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Feature-flag tooling still reads a catalog source file from the selected checkout with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that maintainer read declares a byte limit.
tools/featureflag/main.go	readPreviousCatalog	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Feature-flag graduation still reads the previous catalog file with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that comparison read declares a byte limit.
tools/featureflag/release_delta.go	readReleaseDelta	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Feature-flag release notes still read a catalog delta file with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that delta read declares a byte limit.
tools/regressionproof/main.go	var:readFileUnder	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Regression proof stores unbounded ReadFileUnder as the reader for changed proof files. Remove this entry when that reader is replaced with a positive byte limit.
tools/regressionproof/targets.go	readRegressionSource	safeio.ReadFileUnder	1	Regression proof still reads changed Go source from the repository with unbounded ReadFileUnder. Remove this entry when that proof read declares a byte limit.
